_note: Who can sign in to EPIK Support and with which role. Each entry links an email to a person in queues.json. Emails stay out of git (the repo is public): set them in the CX_USERS environment variable as email=personId pairs, comma separated, e.g. name@getepik.in=khadija. Anyone else from the domain signs in as a viewer. CX_ADMIN_EMAILS lists admins.
